SetupActions.Text: If you used the original pack, unsubscribe from old Barricaded World Workshop item 2696986935 and remove any remaining copy before using continuation 3529472651. Both provide BarricadedWorld; an enabled-ID preset cannot distinguish them. Other unrelated subscriptions can stay.
Start the game after setup with these mods enabled in the main-menu Mods profile. Fully exit and restart if the game requests a restart; body, hair, and clothing models must load before joining.
Restart the server after settings are applied. Validate a fresh test world with two players before using this selection on the main world; review startup and gameplay logs.
Use a fresh world for DG_MIVehicles. Its author warns that enabling it in an existing world opens the existing vehicles' doors, hoods, and trunks.
Keep vanilla vehicle spawning enabled for VVR. Adding it to an existing world can replace loot in vanilla vehicles.
If the MiniHealthPanel update notice cannot close, temporarily disable NeatUI mods, close the notice once, then restore this server profile and restart.
